participation.context: Answered where he lives, looked, and asked for three years.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named the house, withheld the price and the owner, and kept belief for herself.
participation.name: Anne Shakespeare

story.body: You let her walk you there without the name. You answered the April question more plainly than you had in April. You looked a long time, asked neither whose nor what it cost, and offered three years. She did not take the three years. She will give you till she believes you.

title: Looked at the great house and asked for three years

story.body: You kept the picture on the front, the pane, and the nettles.

title: Looked at the house by the chapel

story.body: You recorded the Chapel Street walk in your Stratford notes: Richard judging the wall sound, Anne eyeing the garden, no price asked, and her answer that she will give you till she believes you.
